subject: Private deployment: lockbox + audit window — exec exception request
messages:
From: Maya Soto <maya.soto@lockcresthealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@lockcresthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lockcrest is moving quickly — procurement + security want to confirm a couple of non-standard items before we can sign: 

- Lockbox requirement: internal Lockcrest-admin lockbox for PII datasets (RBAC so only named Lockcrest identities can access raw customer records; Redwood support staff would have no dev/admin console access except during scheduled escorted audits).
- Audit window: we need the option to run an onsite/virtual audit with a 90-day lookback (logs, telemetry, and access records).
- KMS: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) required for data-at-rest for the private/VPC deployment.

I've attached our SOC2 summary and a first-pass DPA mark-up. Procurement needs commercial confirmation on whether these are acceptable and if there are any surcharge/discount implications for the Private deployment seat pricing.

Can you confirm next steps and whether this will need exec signoff? We are targeting a December go-live.

Best,
Maya Soto
Director, Strategic Procurement
Lockcrest Health

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, Redwoods_DPA_draft.docx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Soto <maya.soto@lockcresthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Thanks Maya — received.

Ben/Neha/Vivek — please see Lockcrest's asks above. Short summary of the ask from procurement/security:

1) Lockbox: Lockcrest requires a deployment lockbox that prevents Redwood support/devs from interactive admin access to customer data; exceptions only via scheduled, escorted sessions.
2) 90-day audit window: access to logs and telemetry for a 90-day lookback for compliance audits.
3) BYOK/KMS integration for the private deployment.

Commercial ask: they want confirmation if these requirements change pricing or need an exception (one-time onboarding fee or ongoing surcharge). Lockcrest is asking whether exec approval is required for the lockbox model and extended audit window.

Ben: can you confirm deal economics implications and whether we need to route to deal desk / laura for discount or SLA credit approval?
Neha: please flag any legal/DPA redlines that will block.
Vivek: can infra operate under a lockbox model and BYOK? Any operational constraints or costs?

I copied the customer so we keep the thread transparent. I'll escalate if we need formal exec signoff.

— Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Soto <maya.soto@lockcresthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Team,

Quick commercial read: Lockbox + BYOK are higher-touch and will require onboarding engineering time + potential design changes. Proposal options:

A) Standard Private: no lockbox, standard 30-day audit logs — list price.
B) Lockbox + BYOK: one-time onboarding fee ($45k) + 7% ongoing surcharge on committed monthly reserved capacity OR a 12% discount in exchange for a 24-month committed contract (offsets the surcharge — customer prefers discount).
C) Audit window extension only: $8k one-time plus 3% surcharge.

We need deal desk/executive approval to accept 90-day audit lookback and to trade discount for lockbox. I recommend we approve option B if execs sign off on the discount trade since it secures a multi-year commitment (deal_id: LOCK-202611).

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/LOCK-202611

Ben
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Ben/Jasmine — thanks for the summary. Approving under these constraints (high level guidance):

- Lockbox model: acceptable if scoped tightly — Lockcrest must provide named identities for lockbox access and agree to escorted audits only (no ad-hoc support access).
- 90-day audit window: acceptable; require Security review sign-off and a documented audit playbook.
- BYOK: acceptable only if KMS integration passes our security checklist.

Commercial trade: I will approve the 12% discount for a 24-month commitment (Option B) provided Legal signs off on DPA changes and we include an upfront one-time onboarding fee of $45k to cover engineering/integrations. Finance must be looped for final approval on revenue recognition.

Routing: Laura -> Neha to finalize DPA redlines. Vivek/Infra to confirm operational runbook and cost implications. Ben/Jasmine to finalize term sheet and get procurement countersigned.


Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Soto <maya.soto@lockcresthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Jasmine/Team — operational notes from infra: 

1) Lockbox: we can implement a lockbox for the Private/VPC offering by restricting RBAC at the control plane and implementing an escorting process. This requires a small feature set: named-service-accounts for lockbox admins, audit-escort workflow, and UI toggles. Estimated engineering scoping: 4–6 weeks for delivery and a dedicated runbook.
2) BYOK/KMS: supported but with additional key-rotation and key-recovery clauses — we need to reflect this in the SOW and add a one-time integration cost (~$10k) for KMS plumbing and testing.
3) 90-day audit lookback: we can retain 90 days of detailed telemetry but will need additional log retention (+storage cost) and a formal audit-playbook; estimated monthly storage delta ~ $1.2k.

I've attached the onprem_ops_runbook draft for the customer's read. Operational pre-reqs: scheduled maintenance windows, limited emergency access (requires on-call escrow approval), and an escorted audit schedule (48-hour notice).

If Finance/legal approve the commercial package (12% discount + $45k onboarding + $10k KMS hookup), we can commit to Dec go-live with parallel infra sprint.

-Vivek
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

Attachments: onprem_ops_runbook.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Soto <maya.soto@lockcresthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment — lockbox and extended audit window request

Team/Maya — legal read: we can accept the lockbox and 90-day audit window subject to the following redlines in the DPA and SOW:

- Limit liability exposure for data access to breach-related incidents; do not accept open-ended indemnity for escorted audits.
- BYOK: require clear key custody terms and recovery responsibilities; add language around support-assisted key recovery with explicit customer authorization.
- Audit scope: define exact artifacts available (logs, access-control events) and exclude developer sandbox consoles. Audit execution requires a scope document and our staff escort; ad-hoc access requests will be denied.

Maya — please confirm you'll accept those carve-outs. Once procurement consents, I'll prepare final DPA redlines and route a signature packet. Per Laura's instruction, commercial terms (12% discount + $45k onboarding + $10k KMS integration) need Finance confirmation.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
